_comment: Operator-maintained source for Borough President + District Attorney + County Clerk (METRO_EXPANSION_PLAYBOOK 11.3). Fill each name from the official BP/DA site and set url to that official page, then run scripts/build_borough_officials.py. Leave a name null to omit it (the card then links to the NYC Green Book instead of naming anyone). NEVER guess a name - these are elected offices and a wrong name is a real error.
_verified: 2026-07-13 - each name confirmed on the office's own official site (Queens BP canonical queensbp.nyc.gov; SI DA statenislandda.org); BP set cross-checked against Wikipedia. Re-verify before/after each election cycle. | County Clerks: this file is NO LONGER the only source for that row. The names here were verified 2026-07-20 on each office's nycourts.gov page, where only Bronx and Kings publish the incumbent; that host has been behind a Cloudflare managed challenge since 2026-09-26 and cannot be re-read. From 2026-09-29, by Adam's ruling, build_borough_officials.py fills a clerk whose name here is null from the NYC Green Book (Socrata mdcw-n682, scraped weekly by greenbook_clerk_scraper.py) and stamps it nameSource. IT NEVER OVERWRITES A NAME WRITTEN HERE - so filling a clerk name in this file takes that borough back off the Green Book, and the Bronx, where the two publishers disagree, stays exactly as it is until the operator rules. NYC County Clerks are APPOINTED (by the Appellate Division), so the card labels the row appointed and there is no election return behind any of them.
